# Content-asset engineering system

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @dontbesilent2025's content-structuring system: once you have enough material (50+ files or 80k+ characters), it audits your corpus, builds a fixed local project (rules, raw-material vault, content-unit library of QST/CON/OPI/CAS/SOL units, topic maps, assembly drafts, tooling), and progresses through gated audit → sample → batch → full modes — originals never rewritten, everything traceable. Honest caveats: **no license declared in the repository — license unknown**, so this is a short fiche linking to the source, without reusing its content; written for Chinese-speaking users; a heavy-weight system — it explicitly refuses to build if your corpus is too small.
